chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who forgets, while he is behind the Imam, to recite tasbih in sajdah or in rukuʿ, or forgets to say something between the two sajdahs.
He said: “There is nothing upon him.”

key_terms.السُّجُودِ: the state of prostration in salat
key_terms.بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ: the sitting interval between the two prostrations
key_terms.خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ: while praying behind the Imam in congregational salat
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ: there is no penalty, obligation, or corrective burden upon him
key_terms.يَنْسَى: forgets unintentionally during the act of worship
key_terms.يُسَبِّحَ: to recite tasbih, glorifying Allah in prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone praying behind the Imam forgets the tasbih in rukuʿ or sajdah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one praying behind the Imam in congregational salat. If he forgets the tasbih in rukuʿ or sajdah, or forgets to say something between the two sajdahs, no liability or penalty is upon him.
